items: Pre-registered test
endpoints locked 2026-09-03; 12-month tier spread and information coefficient on the frozen 2026-08-28 vintage, the whole 15,797-name universe included, the basket against the S&P stated either way
Forward test, 53 ranked
accruing, day 8 of 365; one look per week
Forward test, full universe
accruing; every one of the 15,797 first-screen judgments faces the same clock
Momentum contamination
score vs trailing-year return, Spearman -0.20 over 52 names: the rubric is not last year's winners in a lab coat
Weights vs measurement
1,000 weight perturbations, rank stability 0.995: the measurement, not the weights, produces the order. Cronbach alpha 0.47: six measures, six properties
Independent bets
14.5 effective bets across 52 names, average pairwise correlation 0.08: more independent wagers than the health share implies
Blind second scorer

gate verdicts 16 of 16 over two seeded batches; totals within 5.9 of 100; ordering holds where levels genuinely differ (rho 0.85 in the wide batch) and dissolves inside a tier band (0.05 in the narrow one), so tier edges deserve less confidence than the gate
Screen error bar
24 registered cuts blind re-scored in two batches: agreement rho 0.76, one confirmed false negative (VMD, blind six-measure grade t2), one recorded score corrected (IRS), zero new misses in batch two
Attribution

external, against the French library over 27 weeks: market beta 0.86, six factors explain 69% of variance, alpha after loadings -8.6% a year at t=-0.5; the registered rule says the thesis survives only if alpha remains, and the window is still short
Universe freshness
